narr: The first active convective day of the 2024 monsoon produced several thunderstorms that resulted in strong winds and flash flooding. Notably, a 61 MPH wind gust occurred at Pioneer Airfield at Fort Huachuca and separately, Flash Flooding and severe wind gusts were observed in the town of Pima in Graham County.
ev: Several rounds of thunderstorms moved over the Pima area from 6 PM until after 10 PM in the evening. This caused extensive street flooding and flash flooding with water running curb to curb on numerous streets.
lsr: Reports of flooding of streets in Pima.
